study: Intraday pairs reversion. When two stocks that normally move together drift apart inside a session, does buying the laggard and shorting the leader earn the gap back within 60 minutes, after costs on all four legs? Market-neutral. No indicator.
registered_at: 2026-10-19, before any pair spread, beta, or return in this study was computed.
origin: Operator 2026-10-19, after the project review: about 90 studies tested one idea (price-indicator timing on 1-minute bars, liquid names, 3-10 minute holds). This is outside it: the edge, if any, is the relative gap between two related names, not direction; the hold is tens of minutes; it is market-neutral. No pairs, cointegration, or stat-arb study exists in docs/studies.
what_a_session_is: Every trade opens and closes inside one regular session. Half A, sessions on or before 2026-07-23, is where each pair's hedge ratio and spread scale are fit. Half B, sessions after 2026-07-23, is the call. The split is which sessions, not a hold.

arms.P1_declared: The pairs listed in pairs_declared, chosen on economic grounds before any data: same business, same drivers. Fixed now.
arms.P2_chosen: The 40 pairs with the highest correlation of 5-minute SIP returns over half A, computed on 09:45-15:50 bars only, among names present on every half-A session and both in the half-A top 300 by median dollar volume. Picked greedily by correlation with each name in at most 3 pairs, so banks, semis, and share classes cannot fill the list. Chosen on half A only and frozen before half B is read. A P1 pair can appear in P2.

spread: For pair (A, B) on a session: d_t = ln(A_t / A_0945) - beta * ln(B_t / B_0945), from SIP 1-minute closes, anchored on the 09:45 close so the opening auction and the overnight gap are not in the spread; both legs must have a 09:45 bar or the pair skips that session. beta is the half-A least-squares slope of A's 5-minute log return on B's (no intercept, 09:45-15:50). sigma is the half-A standard deviation of d_t over minutes 10:00-15:00. beta and sigma are frozen after half A. d is evaluated at minute m only when both legs printed a bar in minute m; a stale close is never carried forward to trigger an entry or an exit.
entry: At the close of minute m, 10:00 <= m <= 15:00 ET, if |d_m| >= 2 sigma and the pair has no open trade: short the leg that is ahead, buy the leg that is behind. Dollar sizes: 1 on A, beta on B, opposite signs. Fill at the SIP open of minute m+1 on both legs. At most one open trade per pair; after an exit the pair may re-enter only after |d| has been below 1 sigma.
exit: The first of: d crosses 0 (close of the minute it crosses), 60 minutes after entry, or 15:50. Exit at the SIP open of the next minute on both legs (15:50 exits at the 15:50 close). No stop. No flat fill of a missing minute: a leg with no bar at the fill minute uses its next bar; a trade whose leg has no bar within 3 minutes is dropped and counted.
return: Trade return in bp of gross notional (1 + |beta|), the sum of the two legs. Cost: the project's measured 3 bp round trip per name, charged on each leg's own notional, is 3 bp of gross notional. The call is net of 3 bp of gross notional. A 6 bp net (a deliberate 2x haircut for short-side slippage and wider intraday spreads) and gross are printed. Each pair's 2 sigma is printed in bp so a pair whose 2 sigma is below cost by construction is visible.

controls.placebo_partner: The mechanism control. For each pair, leg A is paired with a placebo partner drawn by seed sha256(A|placebo|k|pairs-revert), k = 0, 1, 2, ...: the first drawn warehouse name that is present on at least 100 of the 119 sessions, whose half-A 5-minute correlation with A is below the median of all names' correlation with A, and whose half-A beta is > 0. beta and sigma are fit on half A the same way and the identical 2 sigma rule is run. The partner of every pair is printed. Shorting a leg that ran and buying one that lagged earns plain single-name reversal even with no pair relationship; the placebo earns that too. The pair arm must beat its placebo set.
controls.same_pair_quiet: For each trade, the same pair on the same session at a seeded random minute in the same clock hour with |d| < 0.5 sigma, same side, same 60-minute / 15:50 exit. Information: whether holding the pair is drift.
controls.random_side: The same trade with the side flipped, printed only to show the sign is not market drift.

call: One call per arm on half B, net of 3 bp of gross notional, day-clustered over sessions (each session's mean trade). PASS: net > 0 with t >= 2.24 (Bonferroni for two arms); the arm-minus-placebo excess (defined in excess) > 0 with t >= 2.24 over at least 30 paired sessions; at least 30 sessions with a trade and 300 trades; and the net keeps its sign without the 3 best sessions and without the 5 best pairs (and without the 5 best names). PROMISING (project tier, 2026-10-16): net > 0 on both halves, combined t >= 1.5, arm-minus-placebo excess > 0 on both halves, and the same concentration checks keep the sign. Half A is in-sample for beta, sigma and, for P2, the pair choice: a half-A number is never evidence on its own. UNDERPOWERED when half B has fewer than 30 sessions with a trade or fewer than 300 trades, or more than 5% of trades are dropped for a missing leg. FAIL otherwise.
what_is_printed: Presence table first. Then per arm and half: sessions, trades, trades per session, gross, net 3 bp, net 6 bp, t, placebo net and the excess with its t, quiet-control gross, win share, median hold minutes, exit reason counts (cross / 60 min / 15:50), dropped trades. Per pair on half B: 2 sigma in bp, beta, trades, gross, net. The net without the 3 best sessions, without the 5 best pairs, and without the 5 best names.
data: The minute-bar warehouse (tools/studies/warehouse_fetch.py): ai_reports/warehouse/sip/<day>.npz, 119 sessions 2026-04-28..2026-10-15, all names in the warehouse (not the 400-name sample). SIP for spreads and fills. A pair is scored on a session only if both names are in that session's file. The run refuses unless n = 119, first = 2026-04-28, last = 2026-10-15, and the median split is 2026-07-23.
known_limits: SIP-only: the live desk reads IEX, so a PASS needs an IEX-feature replication under its own prereg before any use. Shorting is assumed available at no borrow fee intraday (large caps, easy to borrow); hard-to-borrow is not checked. 119 sessions is short for pairs whose relationship drifts; a PASS is a paper-forward candidate, never money.
no_retuning: The declared list, the P2 rule (top 40, 09:45-15:50 correlation, at most 3 pairs per name), leg order, 09:45 anchor, 2 sigma entry, 1 sigma re-arm, 0-cross / 60-minute / 15:50 exit, 10:00-15:00 entry window, the placebo rule, 3 bp cost, the split, and the sample are fixed. Anything else is a new prereg.
command: On the mini, after a result-skeptic Mode 1 READY on this prereg and its script, and only then: mkdir -p /tmp/pairs_job; scp tools/studies/pairs_revert.py and docs/studies/pairs_revert_prereg.json to /tmp/pairs_job/ (the script reads the pair list from the prereg next to it), then REPO=$PWD nice -n 19 .venv/bin/python /tmp/pairs_job/pairs_revert.py (presence and fits), then the same with --score. No pytest over SSH. No config edit.
legs: A is the leg with the higher half-A median dollar volume. beta must be > 0; a pair with beta <= 0 is dropped and printed.
presence: Printed first, before any return: for every declared and P2 pair, the number of the 119 sessions on which both names are in the warehouse. A declared pair with either name in fewer than 100 sessions is reported MISSING and left out of the arm, never dropped silently.
amendment_2026-10-19: Result-skeptic Mode 1 NOT READY before any script or result. Fixed: placebo-partner control and same-hour quiet control; cost stated in gross-notional units (3 bp call, 6 bp printed) with each pair's 2 sigma in bp; leg order and beta > 0; both legs must print in the minute; P2 on 09:45-15:50 with a 3-pairs-per-name cap; concentration checks in the call; presence table and MISSING; PROMISING needs the excess on both halves.
excess: Arm-minus-placebo excess: for each session on which both the arm and its placebo set traded, the arm's mean net trade minus the placebo set's mean net trade; the excess is the mean of those per-session differences, with a day-clustered t over those sessions. The number of sessions used is printed.
cost_note: 3 bp is the measured round trip for names under the desk's 0.05% spread cap. P2's top-300 names carry no such cap, so a narrow pass at 3 bp is read against the printed 6 bp line before it is believed.
amendment_2026-10-19b: Result-skeptic Mode 1 round 2, before any script or result: the excess is defined per session over sessions where both traded; the placebo draw re-draws until a partner with beta > 0 and >= 100 sessions is found, and every partner is printed.
